exceptions.reason: The latest stable release removes transforms required by the current package and documentation build chains.
exceptions.removalCondition: Remove the pin when the latest stable release is accepted by both build chains and make test-ts docs-verify-idempotent passes.

exceptions.reason: The latest stable release is outside the current lint peer contract and breaks declaration generation.
exceptions.removalCondition: Remove the pin when the lint peer contract accepts the release and make test-ts passes with declaration output enabled.

exceptions.reason: vsce refuses to package an extension whose @types/vscode is newer than engines.vscode (^1.138.0): "@types/vscode ^1.140.0 greater than engines.vscode ^1.138.0". The extension uses no API added after VS Code 1.138, so raising engines.vscode would only exclude VS Code 1.138 and 1.139.
exceptions.removalCondition: Remove the exception when engines.vscode is raised to the latest @types/vscode release, because the extension needs an API of that release, and make vscode-package test-vscode-integration passes.
